messages:
teo (design): quick sync request 1 we keep getting user reports where a shared console link opens a 404 because the model was archived. proposal: introduce a resolution step for deep links that tries 1) resolve id -> current context, 2) if archived, offer 'open latest' or 'view archive' with clear labeling, and 3) add a URL contract `v` param so we can evolve query names without breaking shares. thoughts?

marta (ux): yes please. shared pain is users clicking a link and losing context. UX should avoid silent redirects. microcopy: "This link points to an archived resource. Open latest version?" with buttons: "Open latest" and "View archive". add a small note: "Link provided via: <whoever>".

naveen (eng): implementation sketch: route `/r/:resourceId` -> resolver service returns {status: active|archived|moved, target: /models/..., meta}. client then either pushes canonical route or shows a resolver modal. also we'll add `?v=1` to all generated links so future param renames can increment `v=2` and resolver can map old names.

cass (frontend): accessibility: modal must trap focus and include `aria-live` region with concise announcement: "Link resolved: resource archived. Showing options." default focus should be the primary action. keyboard-only flow needs explicit "Back to console" link.

lina (product): analytics: record `link_resolution` events with fields: `status`, `action_taken` (open_latest/view_archive/ignore), `via` (sidebar/email/chat). we can use that to see how often archival links are shared. also default behavior: open latest if user is in the same org, otherwise show modal.

teo (design): copy nits: use "Open most recent" instead of "Open latest"? slightly clearer. also tooltip for permalink should read "Copy shareable link (versioned)".

naveen (eng): note on canonicalization: when we push canonical route after resolve, include `?rsrc=origId&v=1&resolved=true` so we can trace back. also for moved items return `redirect_reason` for telemetry.

cass (frontend): small code sketch for resolver behavior:
```js
// on load: if path matches /r/:id -> call /api/resolve/:id
// if active -> replaceState with target
// if archived/moved -> open modal with actions
```

marta (ux): visual hint: breadcrumb should show a subtle pill when a resource is archived e.g., "(archived)" and clicking the crumb goes to the archive listing. avoid using red - use neutral tone.

lina (product): privacy: ensure archived flags aren't leaking sensitive info in URL. keep resolver responses minimal for unauthenticated requests. resolver returns safe redirects with no filter details.

teo (design): accessibility follow-up: aria copy for modal announcement: "This link points to an archived resource. Choose to open the most recent version or view archived details." will that work?

cass (frontend): yes. also ensure `role=dialog` and `aria-modal=true`. add focusable "Details" link for screen reader users.

naveen (eng): backwards compatibility: we'll support links without `v` for now. resolver will assume `v=0` and try to map params. later we can reject unknown `v` with a helpful page.

marta (ux): onboarding hint: when users copy a link from the console, show a small toast: "Link copied (versioned). Older links will still resolve." so authors know we're adding contracting.

lina (product): ok action items: naveen to draft resolver API and mapping rules, cass to prototype modal and aria behavior, marta to write microcopy variants, teo to update permalink tooltip copy, i'll add telemetry keys. sync next Wed. :thumbsup:
